metadata.name: buy_wall_amm
metadata.description: A Pipeline strategy whose markets own their liquidity: a token against wrapped SOL on a constant-product curve with an inventory cap and a buy wall below the price, a port of IMD's Pool4 design

instructions.name: pay_rewards
docs: Custom action, a permissionless keeper job: pays all of `rewards_owed` to the rewards
recipient's associated token account for the token, created at the caller's expense
if missing; refused when nothing is owed. No tip. Remaining accounts are the token's
transfer-hook accounts.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays for the recipient's token account if it is missing.

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: missing (`recipient::ensure`).

instructions.name: pipeline_init_market
docs: Creates a market. `data` is the Borsh encoding of [`InitParams`].

accounts.name: market_signer
docs: The router's market PDA for this market state; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: market_state
docs: A fresh keypair the creator signs with (`init.market_state` is `new_keypair`).

accounts.name: payer
docs: A router PDA holding the SOL the creator allowed for setup. Rent comes from it; the
router returns what is left to the creator.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: The token, index 0. Its extensions are checked against the allowlist before the
vaults are created.

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: Wrapped SOL, index 1.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: transfer and burn out of them; it holds nothing itself.

accounts.name: token_vault
docs: handler once the parameters and the mint rules have been checked (`vaults.rs`).

accounts.name: sol_vault
docs: token vault.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The token's program, SPL Token or Token-2022.

accounts.name: sol_token_program
docs: SPL Token, wrapped SOL's program.

instructions.name: pipeline_market_info
docs: Reports the market's mints (the token at index 0, wrapped SOL at index 1), its
vaults and that it does not support exact-out.

instructions.name: pipeline_quote
docs: Prices an exact-in trade without changing anything; refuses exact-out.

instructions.name: pipeline_resolve_accounts
docs: Lists the accounts a swap needs after the router's ten: the output vault and the
vault authority.

instructions.name: pipeline_seed_liquidity
docs: Pipeline's optional extension, called by another program such as a launchpad
graduating a token: creates a market at the PDA `["seeded", seeder, token_mint,
wsol_mint]` from the creation parameters in `request.data` (with the signing seeder in
place of theirs), takes `request.amounts` from the seeder's escrows, opens it as
`seed` does and returns `SeedResult { taken, lp_amount: 0 }`. Remaining accounts are
the token's transfer-hook accounts.

accounts.name: seeder
docs: A PDA of the calling program, signing; it owns the escrows and becomes the seeder.

accounts.name: payer
docs: A system account holding the SOL the caller allows for rent.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: The token, index 0. Its extensions are checked against the allowlist before the
vaults are created.

accounts.name: token_escrow
docs: The seeder's own token account of the token (owned by the seeder, not merely
delegated to it), as the `seed` action requires of the seeder's accounts.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The token's program, SPL Token or Token-2022.

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: Wrapped SOL, index 1.

accounts.name: sol_escrow
docs: The seeder's own wrapped SOL account.

accounts.name: sol_token_program
docs: SPL Token, wrapped SOL's program.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: nothing itself.

accounts.name: token_vault
docs: handler (`vaults.rs`).

accounts.name: sol_vault
docs: token vault.

instructions.name: pipeline_swap
docs: Settles an exact-in trade the router sends: pays the trader from the output vault,
books the fee, the ledgers, the price and the counters, then lowers the inventory
cap or trims the curve, emitting `CapLowered` or `Trimmed`.

accounts.name: market_signer
docs: The router's market PDA; compared with the stored market signer.

accounts.name: output_token_program
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022, and the owner of the output vault: the swap lends it the
vault authority's signature, so it must be the vault's own program.

instructions.name: place_wall
docs: Custom action, a permissionless keeper job: closes the buy wall at the current price
and places it again with everything idle, at the lower of the price and the wall's
floor, tipping the caller in wrapped SOL; refused until `idle_sol` or the SOL the
wall has spent reaches `WALL_THRESHOLD`.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; named in the event.

accounts.name: tip_account
docs: Any wrapped SOL account, for the tip; never the SOL vault itself.

instructions.name: seed
docs: Custom action: seeds and opens a market, signed by its seeder, once. Remaining
accounts are the token's transfer-hook accounts.

accounts.name: seeder
docs: The market's stored seeder; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: seeder_token
docs: The seeder's own token account (owned by the seeder, not merely delegated to them).

accounts.name: seeder_sol
docs: The seeder's own wrapped SOL account.

instructions.name: set_fee_recipient
docs: Custom action: the fee recipient hands its role, and what the role is owed, to `new`,
which must not be the default key.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: The role's current recipient.

instructions.name: set_rewards_recipient
docs: Custom action: the rewards recipient hands its role, and what the role is owed, to
`new`, which must not be the default key.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: The role's current recipient.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Custom action, a permissionless keeper job: splits the retired tokens, the reward share
joining `rewards_owed` and the rest burned from the token vault; refused when nothing
is retired. No tip, and nobody signs but whoever pays the transaction fee.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: Written by the burn, which lowers its supply.

instructions.name: sweep_fees
docs: Custom action, a permissionless keeper job: pays fee slot `slot`'s whole ledger in
wrapped SOL to its wallet's associated token account, created at the caller's expense
if missing: 0 the fee recipient, 1 `DESIGNER_RECIPIENT` (refused while it is unset), 2
`SUITE_TREASURY`; refused when nothing is owed. No tip.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays for the recipient's token account if it is missing.

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: missing (`recipient::ensure`).

types.name: CapLowered
docs: A swap left the curve holding less than the inventory cap and the ratchet lowered the
cap (docs/spec/pool4-for-solana.md, "After pricing" step 6).

fields.name: cap
docs: The new inventory cap, in token units.

fields.name: lowered_by
docs: How far the cap fell, in token units.

fields.name: held
docs: What the curve holds at the swap's price, in token units.

fields.name: decay_credit
docs: The decay credit left, in token-seconds.

types.name: FeesSwept
docs: `sweep_fees` paid one fee slot's whole ledger to its wallet
(docs/spec/pool4-for-solana.md, "`sweep_fees { slot }`").

fields.name: slot
docs: 0 the fee recipient, 1 the designer share, 2 the suite share.

fields.name: token_account
docs: The recipient's associated wrapped SOL account.

fields.name: amount
docs: Lamports sent, in wrapped SOL.

constants.name: DECAY_CREDIT_WINDOW
docs: The most cap decay allowance that builds up while a market is idle, in seconds.
Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), where the demo script reads it (`POOL4-30`).

constants.name: DESIGNER_RECIPIENT
docs: The wallet the designer share is paid to. Unset (the all-zero key) while IMD and Adam
have no known Solana address; an upgrade sets it before the program is frozen.
Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), where the demo script reads it, as is the suite
treasury below (`POOL4-40`).

constants.name: DESIGNER_SHARE_BPS
docs: The designer share, owed to IMD and Adam, in basis points of the fee (10%).
Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), where the demo script reads it (`POOL4-25`).

constants.name: FLOOR_CRAWL_BPS
docs: How fast the wall's floor may rise, in basis points of the price a day.

constants.name: KEEPER_TIP_CAP
docs: The most a wall placement tips its caller (0.002 SOL).

constants.name: MIN_LIQUIDITY
docs: The least liquidity the curve may ever hold.
Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), where the demo script reads it (`POOL4-30`).

constants.name: REF_STEP_BPS
docs: How fast the reference may follow the price: `REF_STEP_BPS` of the price per
`REF_STEP_WINDOW` seconds.

constants.name: REF_STEP_WINDOW
docs: See `REF_STEP_BPS`, in seconds.

constants.name: SUITE_SHARE_BPS
docs: The suite share, in basis points of the fee (10%).
Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), where the demo script reads it (`POOL4-25`).

constants.name: SUITE_TREASURY
docs: The suite treasury, the same wallet the tax AMM pays its suite share to; its key is in
`~/.config/testing-pipeline/devnet/suite-treasury.json` and docs/toolchain.md ("Keys").

constants.name: WALL_THRESHOLD
docs: Idle SOL, or SOL the wall has spent, that lets the wall be placed again (0.01 SOL).
Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), where the demo script reads it, as are the tip cap
and the guard's rates below (`POOL4-35`).
